title: Week 2
priceNote: Prices are estimates from typical Aldi and Publix shelf prices and do not include tax. This week is lighter because it uses up what is left from week 1.
allergyNote: Nothing on this plan contains tree nuts or fish. Peanut butter and hummus are often made in plants that also handle tree nuts. If your allergy is strict, check the labels for a 'may contain tree nuts' line.
weekendNote: Festival days. Leftovers waiting for you: a portion of tikka masala and two bowls of chili in the freezer. Two carnitas portions are still frozen from week 1.
snacks: Hummus with cucumber and pepper strips

mon.heads: Move one carnitas portion from the freezer to the fridge Sunday night.

wed.heads: Start the chili in the crock pot this morning.

thu.heads: Leftover night: reheat the second sheet-pan portion after pickleball.

prep.title: Sunday prep
prep.makes: 3 shawarma bowl lunches, 3 jars of overnight oats, 6 hard-boiled eggs
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Marinate the chicken thighs in the yogurt and spices while it heats.
Cook 1½ cups of rice.
Roast the shawarma chicken for 22 to 25 minutes.
Air-fry 6 eggs at 270°F for 15 minutes, then move them to ice water.
Quick-pickle half the red onion in lemon juice and salt. Chop the cucumber and tomatoes.
Mix 3 jars of peanut butter banana overnight oats.
Slice the chicken and pack 3 bowls. Keep the salad and sauce in their own containers.
Move one carnitas portion from the freezer to the fridge for Monday.

prep.title: Wednesday morning
prep.makes: Chili for two tonight, Thursday and Friday lunches, 2 freezer bowls
steps: Brown the turkey in a skillet for 6 minutes.
Add it to the crock pot with the sweet potatoes, onion, garlic, beans, tomatoes, broth and spices.
Set it on low for 7 to 8 hours and head out.
Tonight, air-fry tortilla strips for the topping.

pb-oats.name: Peanut butter banana overnight oats
steps: Mash one banana in a bowl and stir in the milk, yogurt, peanut butter, honey, cinnamon and salt.
Stir in the oats.
Split across 3 jars and top with the sliced banana.
Refrigerate overnight. They keep 4 days. Eat cold or microwave 60 seconds.

breakfast-tacos.name: Black bean breakfast tacos
steps: Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet, then wrap them in a towel.
Spray the skillet and wilt the spinach with the beans for 1 minute.
Add the whisked eggs and salt and scramble gently until just set.
Fill the tortillas and top with cheese and salsa.
breakfast-tacos.tip: Good fuel before Tuesday and Thursday pickleball.

hb-eggs.name: Air-fryer hard-boiled eggs
steps: Put the eggs straight into the air fryer basket.
Cook at 270°F for 15 minutes.
Move them to a bowl of ice water for 5 minutes, then refrigerate.

shawarma-chicken.name: Sheet-pan chicken shawarma
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan.
Stir the yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, spices, salt and oil together and coat the chicken.
Spread the thighs flat on the pan.
Roast 22 to 25 minutes, until the edges char.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice.

shawarma-bowl.name: Chicken shawarma bowl
steps: Quick-pickle the red onion in half the lemon juice and a pinch of salt for 15 minutes.
Toss the cucumber and tomatoes with a squeeze of lemon and salt.
Stir the yogurt with the remaining lemon, dill and salt for the sauce.
Build each bowl on spinach and rice with chicken, salad, onions and a scoop of hummus. Pack the sauce on the side.

carnitas-quesadillas.name: Carnitas and pepper quesadillas
steps: Sear the pepper and onion in the dry cast iron for 5 minutes, then crisp the carnitas alongside for 3 minutes.
Lay 2 tortillas in the pan, add cheese, the filling, more cheese and the top tortillas.
Press with a spatula and cook 2 to 3 minutes a side until crisp and melted.
Cut into quarters and serve with salsa, yogurt and cilantro.
carnitas-quesadillas.tip: Free dinner from last week's freezer. Two carnitas portions are still frozen.

sheetpan-sausage.name: Sheet-pan chicken sausage and potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the potatoes with half the oil and seasoning and roast 12 minutes.
Add the sausage, peppers and onion with the rest of the oil and seasoning.
Roast 15 to 18 minutes more, until the potatoes are crisp.
Pack half for Thursday.
sheetpan-sausage.tip: Add a cottage cheese cup on the side to push past 40g of protein.

turkey-chili.name: Crock-pot turkey and sweet potato chili
steps: Brown the turkey in a skillet for 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Put everything except the toppings and tortillas in the crock pot and stir.
Cook on low 7 to 8 hours or high 4 hours.
For crunchy strips, spray the tortilla strips and air-fry at 380°F for 5 to 6 minutes.
Top bowls with cheese, yogurt, green onion, cilantro and strips. Freeze 2 bowls.
turkey-chili.tip: Dinner for two tonight, lunch Thursday and Friday.

tikka-masala.name: Chicken tikka masala
steps: Toss the chicken with the yogurt, 2 tsp garam masala, the paprika and ½ tsp salt. Let it sit 15 minutes, or all day in the fridge.
Start the rice. Sear the chicken in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes and set it aside. It does not need to cook through.
Cook the onion in the same pan for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, cumin and the rest of the garam masala for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce and simmer 5 minutes, then stir in the coconut milk.
Return the chicken and simmer 10 minutes until thick. Salt to taste.
Warm the naan and serve over rice with cilantro.
tikka-masala.tip: This week's new one. Coconut milk stands in for cream, so it stays lighter.
